e.title: GB2
e.summary: 广义贝塔第二类分布（CRAN 2.1.2）：GB2 密度/分布/分位/矩 + 复合混合 + 伪似然拟合——保险损失分布核心族
e.summary_en: Generalised Beta of the Second Kind (CRAN 2.1.2): GB2 density/cdf/quantiles/moments + compound mixture + pseudo-likelihood fitting — core insurance loss distribution family
e.summary_hk: 廣義貝塔第二類分佈（CRAN 2.1.2）：GB2 密度/分佈/分位/矩 + 複合混合 + 偽似然擬合——保險損失分佈核心族
e.body: GB2（CRAN 2.1.2，Graf & Nedyalkova）探索广义贝塔第二类（GB2）分布：密度/分布函数/分位数/矩、全/剖面对数似然与得分、不平等与贫困指标、最大伪似然与非线性最小二乘拟合、基于复合性质的混合分布（左/右尾离散化）——GB2 族包含 Pareto、Weibull、Gamma 等特例，是保险损失分布的灵活核心族。对 RIAA：损失分布族的权威实现——[[actuar-r]]（actuar 重尾分布）的 GB2 专项；GB2 在再保险定价（[[reinsurance]]）与损失建模（[[insurance-severity]]）中的灵活形状（双参数控制双尾）；复合混合处理异质性；Graf/Nedyalkova 的学术实现；适合损失分布建模方向。
e.body_en: GB2 (CRAN 2.1.2, Graf & Nedyalkova) explores the [[generali|Generali]]sed Beta distribution of the second kind: density/cdf/quantiles/moments, full and profile log-likelihoods with scores, inequality and poverty indicators, maximum pseudo-likelihood and nonlinear least-squares fitting, a mixture distribution based on the GB2 compounding property (left/right-tail discretisation) — the GB2 family includes Pareto, Weibull and Gamma as special cases, making it a flexible core family for insurance loss distributions. For RIAA: the authoritative implementation of a loss-distribution family — the GB2 specialist beyond [[actuar-r]] (actuar heavy tails); GB2's flexible shapes (two parameters control both tails) in reinsurance pricing ([[reinsurance]]) and loss modelling ([[insurance-severity]]); compound mixtures handle heterogeneity; academic implementation by Graf/Nedyalkova; suits loss-distribution modelling.
e.body_hk: GB2（CRAN 2.1.2，Graf & Nedyalkova）探索廣義貝塔第二類（GB2）分佈：密度/分佈函數/分位數/矩、全/剖面對數似然與得分、不平等與貧困指標、最大偽似然與非線性最小二乘擬合、基於複合性質的混合分佈（左/右尾離散化）——GB2 族包含 Pareto、Weibull、Gamma 等特例，是保險損失分佈的靈活核心族。對 RIAA：損失分佈族的權威實現——[[actuar-r]]（actuar 重尾分佈）的 GB2 專項；GB2 在再保險定價（[[reinsurance]]）與損失建模（[[insurance-severity]]）中的靈活形狀（雙參數控制雙尾）；複合混合處理異質性；Graf/Nedyalkova 的學術實現；適合損失分佈建模方向。
